properties.content: Oman visa for Bangladeshi citizens Toggle navigation Home Oman visa for Bangladeshi citizens Jan 22, 2025 Oman visa for Bangladeshi citizens By Tagucci Khan in Travel Do Bangladeshi citizens need a visa to visit Oman? Yes, Bangladeshi citizens require a visa to visit Oman. The visa must be obtained before traveling. The option for Bangladeshi travelers is a paper or embassy visa , as eVisas are not currently offered to Bangladeshi nationals visiting for tourism or transit. A visa to Oman is an official travel document that permits foreign nationals to enter the country for a specified purpose and duration. Important: For Bangladeshi citizens, obtaining a visa is mandatory before traveling to Oman, as on-arrival and eVisa options are not currently available. Typically, Bangladeshi travelers can apply for an embassy visa , which is suited for short stays such as tourism or business purposes. The stay and visa validity duration depends on the visa type—usually two weeks to a few months. To apply via the embassy, applicants must prepare essential documents , including: A valid passport Recent photographs A completed visa application form Flight details and proof of accommodation The processing time for an embassy visa can vary, often taking several days to weeks. It’s important to note that the eVisa process is generally more secure and faster for Oman, with applications directly tied to the passport electronically, ensuring seamless verification at border crossings. Ensure all required documents meet the consulate’s guidelines for a smooth application process. Types of Oman Visas Available for Bangladeshi Nationals Understanding the types of Oman visas available for Bangladeshi nationals is crucial for ensuring a hassle-free travel experience. Each visa type is tailored to specific purposes, such as tourism , business , employment , or family visits , and knowing the right one can save both time and resources. Applying for an incorrect visa can lead to delays , rejection , or even complications at entry points. Additionally, each visa type has unique requirements , validity periods , and processing times , making choosing the appropriate category by your travel intentions is essential. Oman offers various types of visas tailored to specific purposes of travel. Below is an in-depth breakdown: 1. Sponsored Visas Employment Visa Required for those seeking employment in Oman. This visa is issued to individuals who have secured a job and are sponsored by their employer. Student Visa For students enrolled in recognized educational institutions in Oman under a sponsor agreement. Family Joining Visa Family members of expatriates working in Oman use this visa to join their relatives. Citizen Spouse Visa Issued to foreign nationals married to Omani citizens. Marriage certificates and sponsorship documents are required. Investor Visa Available for individuals who intend to invest a significant amount in Oman-based businesses. NOTE: Sponsored visas always require an Omani guarantor or a sponsor, such as a company or family member. 2. Unsponsored Resident Visas Property Owner Visa Issued to foreign nationals who own real estate property in Oman. 3. Sponsored Visit Visas Tourist Visa Designed for tourists under the sponsorship of a local tour agency. Business Visit Visa For individuals visiting Oman for business-related engagements under a local sponsor. Family Visit Visa Applicable for visiting immediate family members residing in Oman. Scientific Research Visa For professionals conducting research in Oman with institutional backing. 4. Unsponsored Visit Visas Tourist Visit Visa Multi-entry Offers multiple entries within its validity period. GCC Resident Visa For Bangladeshi nationals residing in one of the GCC countries (e.g., UAE, Qatar) and visiting Oman. NOTE: Check document requirements and validity when applying for these visa categories. For a detailed list of visa types, visit the official Royal Oman Police (ROP) visa services page here: Royal Oman Police Visa Services . Applying for an Oman Regular Visa via the Embassy Bangladeshi citizens must contact the Oman Embassy in Dhaka to apply for a paper or embassy visa. Here are the basic steps: Gather the required documents, including a valid passport, recent photographs, and proof of purpose for the visit. Visit the Oman Embassy in Dhaka to submit your application. Pay the application fee (details provided at the embassy). Wait for processing, which generally takes 2 to 4 weeks. NOTE: Ensure all submitted documents are attested and meet the Omani policies. Step-by-Step Oman eVisa Application Process Although Bangladeshi citizens don’t qualify for an eVisa currently, understanding the general eVisa process may be helpful if future updates allow its use: Step 1. Select Visa Type Navigate the application to choose the appropriate
